g.text: See all your customer conversations in one fast shared inbox —
email, live chat, customer portal, and self-service docs. Answer
fast with AI drafts your team approves before anything is sent.
Nothing charged until you choose a plan
“Could you update our VAT number on…”
“We would love to push events into our CRM…”
Grounded in your docs, verified by humans
“Hi Maya — I’ve updated the VAT number and reissued
invoice 881. It’s attached to this reply.”
